# Official OKF interoperability examples

The four files under `acme_retail/` are unchanged blobs from
[`bundles/acme_retail` at `527e81aff55992be21507e97004286789126f88c`](https://github.com/open-knowledge-format/open-knowledge-format/tree/527e81aff55992be21507e97004286789126f88c/bundles/acme_retail),
licensed under the upstream [Apache-2.0 license](https://github.com/open-knowledge-format/open-knowledge-format/blob/527e81aff55992be21507e97004286789126f88c/LICENSE.md).
They exercise supplied-content validation of a metadata-bearing root, a log,
a deprecated concept with a successor, and a computation with native-looking
timestamps, sources, parameters and SQL. This subset is not a complete bundle;
no test executes the computation or its attester.
